title: Experts disagree on new src/stage-isolation/stage-brief.ts buildStageBrief
context:
Chief architect: the size cap is an acceptance criterion of the request and the host truncates past 10,000 characters; the missing-pillar and session-match tests are compatible and should also be written.

Target: new src/stage-isolation/stage-brief.ts buildStageBrief
- qa-engineer: Given each of the six stages on this repo, a minimal fixture repo, and a fixture whose feature-development.yaml stage instructions are long enough to overflow, when buildStageBrief runs, then the result is at most 9000 characters, and the overflow case ends with the pointer line to docs/instructions/workflows/feature-development.yaml (unit)
- qa-engineer: Given no active change, a closed bundle, or a bundle where plan.json exists but specification.json does not, when the development brief is built, then it lists only pillar files that exist and the no-active-change line when there is none (unit, fixture data)
- qa-engineer: the SE_SESSION value in the brief commands must equal the session the completion hook uses for the stage-agent row; a payload session_id that differs from SE_SESSION is the known session-fork trap and needs its own test
